proposed_widenings.name: force_move.direction: "any_direction"
proposed_widenings.justification: Telekinetic movement is caster-controlled in any direction including vertically (lifting into the air). The existing push/pull/slide directions are relative-to-caster or lateral. "Any direction" including upward is mechanically distinct and needed for honest encoding.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range... if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there

proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition.expiresOn: RiderExpiry
proposed_widenings.justification: The Restrained condition imposed by the creature option expires at 'the end of your next turn', which is a sub-duration window within the spell's concentration window. apply_condition currently has no expiry field; the condition is assumed to persist for the full spell duration. A RiderExpiry (e.g. end_of_next_turn) field on apply_condition is needed to author this honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the Restrained condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the save.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffectMechanics: per-activation target-mode branching (creature vs. object)
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingEffectMechanics has a single fixed 'attachment' established at cast time. Telekinesis lets the caster choose each Magic action whether to target a creature (target attachment) or an object (object attachment). CastTimeEffectModeChoice is per-cast-instance and does not model per-activation branching across different attachment kinds. A per-activation mode selector on OngoingOperation or an overloaded attachment grammar is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation save_gate: object-state predicate (worn/carried vs. not)
proposed_widenings.justification: The object option requires a Str save only if the object is worn or carried by a creature; if not, the move is automatic (no save). save_gate in ongoing operations has no predicate for the physical state of the targeted object. A conditional 'save required if worn or carried' predicate would be needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range. If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell's range.

notes: The payload family (ongoing_effect, on_caster_spends_action trigger, Magic action cost) fits cleanly. The four surface gaps above prevent honest encoding: (1) force_move direction must be extended to cover free caster-directed movement including vertical; (2) apply_condition needs an expiry field for sub-duration conditions; (3) the per-activation creature-vs-object branch requires a per-activation mode mechanism not present in OngoingEffectMechanics; (4) the worn/carried conditional on the object save gate has no object-state predicate. Fine manipulation (opening doors, pouring vials) is DM-agenda narrative and can be omitted. The 'falls at end of turn' consequence is handled by the game's normal gravity rules once the Restrained condition expires, so no dedicated 'fall' atom is needed if (2) is resolved.
